sentences.en: I can't stand that nasty attitude of his any longer.
sentences.zh: 我再也不能忍受他那种讨厌的态度了。

sentences.en: I have to tell him off for his bad attitude.
sentences.zh: 我必须批评一下他的不良态度。

sentences.en: Young people naturally react against the attitudes of their parents.
sentences.zh: 年轻人自然会反对父母的态度。

mnemonic: 发音记忆：“爱踢球的”→尽管人们对国足态度不一，但青少年踢球的热情无法阻挡→态度
